message.content: {"verdict":"BALABLU","reason":"Coins live on the blockchain and the wallet app only holds the keys, so it does not store coins inside the app."}
message.reasoning_content: The claim: "A crypto wallet app stores your coins inside the app." The rule: FACT if coins stored inside the wallet app itself; BALABLU if coins live on blockchain and wallet only holds keys. Evidence says wallets do not hold funds; coins live on blockchain, wallet holds keys. So verdict: BALABLU.
